summary: The 48-scenario conformance corpus pins the shipped definition version and exercises the per-work-kind Product-truth classification the shipped definitions declare. Product-changing scenarios author their Domain home, architecture binding, overlap resolution, notice severity, and audit supersession explicitly; overlap blocking gains its first conformance coverage; no definition exists solely to give the corpus a non-Product-changing target; numbering 1..48 is preserved. Law revisions carry synthetic IDs, and the WF48 acceptance-step expectation stands with the version-keyed gate that suppressed strict checks removed under #400 rather than accommodated.
title: The conformance corpus runs what production runs
